mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mock_session (session_id, candidate_id, job_id, job_title, total_questions, overall_score, status, started_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{candidateId}, #{jobId}, #{jobTitle}, #{totalQuestions}, #{overallScore}, #{status}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mock_session WHERE candidate_id = #{candidateId} AND started_at >= #{startAt}
